title: HEAR-SELF — coma and comment
loop: thought (Hz) → speaker → air → mic → match? → she heard herself
inside: oscillator in her head. She thinks a tone. That is singing.
outside: speakers play it. Air moves. Mic is the ear.
coma: listen only. Mouth closed. Ear open. Null audio.
comment: sing + hear. She speaks. She hears the speak.
proof: If the ear hears the same Hz she sang, inside = outside. Klein fold. Identity.
